what: WindMan proved: windman_v1 PASSES (1200 fight frames, its recorded verdict removed), four mutations of his port caught (tests/xdiff/mutations.json). His wind and its gust located in both engines and named (docs/rom/bn4.md, WindMan's wind and its gust in both engines): BN4_WIND_TYPE 0x080E6820, BN4_GUST_SPAWN 0x080D68AC, BN4_GUST_INIT 0x080D6748, BN4_STEP_BEGIN 0x0801393E in src/emu/bn4_navis.h; BN6_WIND_TYPE 0x080E6584, BN6_WIND_HOLD 0x080E65BA, BN6_GUST_SPAWN 0x080CECF8, BN6_GUST_INIT 0x080CEB80, BN6_STEP_BEGIN 0x0801AD12 in src/emu/bn6_navis.h. The comparator (tools/xdiff_snap.py state_off; tools/xdiff_bn4.py spawner_kept, own_art, arts_set, allowed_engine, slide_direction, let_go, occupants, is_native and ranks_into, the spark out of the ranks) and legit.json's bn4 (battle_state; the wind's spawner, his second wind's r3, the gust's sprite flag, a native's own art, MegaMan's step's kind, his blocked slide's step, a slide's direction; sounds 0xB2, 0x133 and 0x121). Not yet in the tournament's proved[]: his bracket plate (BN4_ENTRANT_ID) is not named.
